votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of June 9, 2020.
votes.description: The Board approved the RDA meeting minutes from June 9, 2020.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 1 of 2022, Repealing and Replacing the Housing Allocation Funds Policy.
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution repealing and replacing the Housing Allocation Funds Policy, incorporating priorities for the Westside Community Initiative (WCI) and renaming the Northwest Quadrant Fund to the WCI Fund.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of discussing pending or reasonably imminent litigation, discussion regarding deployment of security personnel, devices or systems; and attorney-client matters that are privileged pursuant to Utah Code 78B-1-137.
votes.description: The Board voted to enter a closed session to address litigation strategy, security deployment, and privileged attorney-client matters.

votes.motion: Exit the Closed Session and adjourn as the Redevelopment Agency.
votes.description: The Board voted to conclude the closed session and adjourn the RDA meeting.
